tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search flights between two airports or cities. Returns offers with the price in grosze, schedule, fare family and a link to the offer page. Use suggest_places first when you only know a city name.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search hotels in a city or area for given check-in and check-out dates. Returns offers with the total price of the stay, rating, board type and a link to the offer page.

tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Search package holidays and tours to a destination, departing from a given city within a date window.

tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Search car rentals for a pickup place, date and time. Prices cover the whole rental; the drop-off place defaults to the pickup place.

tools.name: search_parking
tools.description: Search airport and city parking for an entry and exit date. Prices cover every calendar day from entry to exit inclusive.

tools.name: search_insurance
tools.description: Get travel insurance quotes for a trip: destination, dates and the age of every insured person. Premiums are calculated by the server.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Refresh one offer by its externalId before booking. Returns the current price, availability, cancellation policy and details, or not_found when the offer has expired.

tools.name: get_flight_fare_rules
tools.description: Get the fare rules of a flight offer: baggage, changes and refunds. The offer is re-priced with the airline on the first call.

tools.name: suggest_places
tools.description: Resolve a city, airport or region name to place suggestions with IATA codes that the search tools accept.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List travel destination guides published on Airsockfly, with hints for searching each destination.

tools.name: get_destination
tools.description: Read one destination guide by slug: highlights, airports, attractions and the best time to go.

tools.name: list_faq
tools.description: Read Airsockfly frequently asked questions about booking, payments and cancellations.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's profile and travel preferences such as language, currency and home airport.

tools.name: list_travellers
tools.description: List travellers saved by the user with names and birth dates. Document numbers are never returned. Use them to fill create_booking.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: List the user's orders, newest first, with status and totals.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Read one order with its bookings, insurance policies, vouchers and invoice reference.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Reserve an offer for the user: re-prices the offer, holds availability and creates an order awaiting payment. Ask the user to confirm the offer, travellers and contact details first. When the result is price_changed, show the new price and call accept_price_change only if the user agrees.

tools.name: accept_price_change
tools.description: Accept the changed price of an order after create_booking returned price_changed, and continue to payment.

tools.name: start_payment
tools.description: Start payment for an order and get a secure Stripe checkout URL. The user must open the URL and pay personally. The agent never pays and must not claim that a payment was made.

tools.name: get_payment_status
tools.description: Check whether an order has been paid and confirmed.

tools.name: preview_cancellation
tools.description: Show what cancelling a booking would cost: penalty, refund and the deadline for free cancellation.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. This is irreversible: call preview_cancellation, tell the user the penalty and refund, and set confirm to true only after the user explicitly agreed.

tools.name: request_date_change
tools.description: Ask to move the dates of a hotel, tour or car rental booking. Creates a change request that the provider handles.

tools.name: list_saved_offers
tools.description: List offers and collections the user saved.

tools.name: toggle_saved_offer
tools.description: Save an offer to the user's favourites, or remove it when it is already saved.

tools.name: list_price_alerts
tools.description: List the user's price alerts.

tools.name: create_price_alert
tools.description: Create a price alert for an offer. The user is notified when the price drops to the threshold.

tools.name: delete_price_alert
tools.description: Delete one of the user's price alerts.

tools.name: get_loyalty
tools.description: Read the user's loyalty points balance and recent point history.

tools.name: list_rewards
tools.description: List rewards the user can get for loyalty points, with their cost in points and remaining stock.

tools.name: redeem_reward
tools.description: Exchange loyalty points for a reward. This spends points: confirm the reward and its cost with the user and set confirm to true only after explicit agreement. Physical rewards need a shipping address.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Read the user's in-app notifications, newest first.

tools.name: list_support_cases
tools.description: List the user's support cases and their status.

tools.name: create_support_case
tools.description: Open a support case with Airsockfly customer service about a booking or another issue.
